title: The Heir at the Window
text: Every night at the third hour, a figure stands at your Seat's high window wearing your heir's face, clothes and smile, while your heir sleeps in bed. The servants have started calling them by both names.

options.label: Send a Scion up to meet it and stare it down.

outcomes.text: Your Scion meets it at the window and does not blink first. It bows and steps back into the glass, leaving a gift wrapped in your heir's own handwriting.
Your Scion meets it at the window, and blinks. In the morning nobody can be quite sure which of them came down the stairs.

options.label: Board up the window to give it nowhere to stand.

outcomes.text: Once the window is boarded, the figure appears at the next window along, then the next, a little nearer the heir's room each night. Then it stops.

options.label: Hang a saint's mirror across from it so it must face itself.

outcomes.text: The figure sees itself in the saint's mirror and screams with your heir's voice, then is gone. Your heir wakes with a nosebleed and a sense of loss.
